Lena (Mktg): Need a compact visual kit for next Wed webinar. Ask: 3 hero images (1200x628, 800x800, 1920x1080), 2 process diagrams (routing + fallback), 1-page SDR crib, and a short 15s animated slide showing graceful fallback. First-pass Tue AM.

Marco (Design): On it. Drop exact headline, stat, and any callout copy. I have Tue morning block. :calendar:

Asha (PMM): Headline: "Predictable inference economics you can budget for". Stat: "~2.3x cost reduction vs naive serving with batching + KV cache (internal benchmark)". CTA: "Configuration guide + live demo".

Lena (Mktg): Figma view: https://figma.com/redwood/inference-kit (assets/marketing). Use swimlane style for diagrams so we can animate. Sparkline needs 3 callouts: baseline / batched+cache / dedicated.

Marco (Design): Callout copy (short pls)

Lena (Mktg): Baseline: "single-request, no batching — higher unit cost"; Batched+cache: "batching + KV cache — lower cost"; Dedicated: "reserved capacity — predictable latency & throughput".

Ben (Legal): Add this exact footnote on stats: "Internal benchmark on representative test workload; actual results vary by model and traffic patterns." Then legal can sign off. :white_check_mark:

Marco (Design): Plan: PNG placeholders Tue 9am, animated spec Tue 4pm. Will push to Figma and tag @Lena @Asha. If anyone wants to review live, I have a 30m slot Tue 10.

KitBot: Comment added on /assets/diagrams/seq-1: "need routing lane labels"

Lena (Mktg): Routing labels: "ingest → policy-router → model-pool → fallback". Owners: Marco (design), Asha (copy), Ben (legal). Thanks! :rocket:
